title: Generation via Classical Noise Reuploading
summary: We propose a novel quantum generative model paradigm that fundamentally avoids the issue of extremely small post-selection probabilities present in previous models. Unlike existing methods that require multi-step noise addition and denoising, this paradigm enables direct single-step generation of quantum data, significantly improving generation efficiency while substantially reducing the complexity of training and quantum state preparation. Furthermore, by directly sampling classical noise to generate quantum states, the sampling process becomes easier to implement. Experimental results…
